ios.desc:
Turns your phone into a simple morse tool, and nothing more.

The app's screen turns white when you touch it, allowing to transmit morse code signals to those who see you.

There's a minimal Morse Code chart at the bottom too; the most recently entered letter is briefly highlighted.

No InApp purchases, no ads.

Most fun when used with another person.

quotes.text:
Somewhat related, my iOS app[1] has a morse code reference and lets you train, it could be useful here.

Its backstory is also a bit silly, it started as the simplest app idea I could think of; I posted more about it recently[2].

[1]: https://apps.apple.com/app/simple-morse-tool/id873021583
